evidence.note: The verse explicitly gives Sarai as the name of Abram’s wife.
God identifies שָׂרַי as Abraham’s wife and gives her the name שָׂרָה.
Kings and their noblewomen appear in parallel. The noun for the women, שָׂרוֹת, is the plural of שָׂרָה.

name: שָׂרַי
summary: Sarai is the name by which Abram’s wife is introduced. Her later name שָׂרָה has the same form as the Hebrew noun for a princess or noblewoman, supporting a similar meaning for Sarai. The text leaves the force of the earlier name’s ending unexplained.
